ids.not_text: {{field}} is not text. Nothing was executed.
ids.too_short: {{field}} "{{value}}" is too short. Nothing was executed: use the {{length}}-character ID shown in the catalog or by a tool.
ids.unknown: {{field}} "{{value}}" does not match any ID shown in this session. Nothing was executed: find the thread or project with the search tool.
ids.ambiguous: {{field}} "{{value}}" is ambiguous: it matches {{matches}}. Nothing was executed: use one of those IDs.
ids.invalid_cli: "{{value}}" is not a valid ID: IDs never start with "-" or contain spaces. Nothing was executed: use the ID shown in the catalog or by a tool.
send.missing_request_id: The server's request identifier is missing (internal failure). Nothing was sent; tell the user.
send.journal_unavailable: ADE Call's send journal could not be opened ({{code}}). Nothing was sent; tell the user: the service needs checking.
send.released_while_preparing: The record of this send was released while it was being prepared. Nothing was sent; tell the user.
release.missing_project_id: projectId is missing: the short ID of the blocked project. Nothing was changed.
release.journal_unavailable: ADE Call's send journal could not be opened or updated. Nothing was changed; tell the user: the service needs checking.
release.in_flight: The send to this project ({{when}}, {{where}}) is in progress right now: it cannot be released. Nothing was changed; wait for its result.
document.not_allowed: Document not allowed: use a relative .md or .txt path of the project and a non-negative integer offset. Private files are not allowed; do not try to get around this restriction.
document.project_unavailable: Project not available in this ADE. Check the projectId in the catalog; do not use another ADE's.
document.out_of_scope: Document out of scope: it must be allowed text inside the project, up to 1 MB. Do not try to get around this restriction.
document.offset_past_end: offset is past the end of the document. Nothing was read: use the offset the previous read gave or start with offset=0.
document.not_found: Project document or folder not found. Check the relative path in the catalog; do not invent its content.
document.no_permission: No permission to read the document. Report the limit; do not try to get around the permissions.
document.unreadable: The project file could not be read. Check its availability; there is no verifiable content.
t3.find.missing_query: query is missing: the name the user said, with at least one word or figure. Nothing was searched.
t3.find.invalid_variants: variants must be a list of up to 5 texts (e.g. ["Whisper"]). Nothing was searched.
t3.find.invalid_flag: {{field}} must be the boolean true or false, not text or a number. Nothing was searched.
t3.find.unknown_project: That projectId is not among the T3 projects. Nothing was searched; pick an ID from the catalog or clarify the project with the user.
t3.list.invalid_flag: {{field}} must be the boolean true or false, not text or a number. Nothing was listed.
t3.read.missing_thread_id: threadId is missing: the short thread ID, from the catalog or a search. Nothing was read.
t3.read.invalid_messages: messages must be an integer from 1 to {{max}} ({{default}} by default). Nothing was read.
t3.read.invalid_offset: offset must be an integer from 0 up: how many recent messages to skip. Nothing was read.
t3.send.missing_project_id: projectId is missing: the short project ID, as it appears in the catalog. Nothing was sent.
t3.send.missing_project: project is missing: the project name, as it appears in the catalog. Nothing was sent.
t3.send.missing_message: message is missing: the request the user accepted. Nothing was sent.
t3.send.invalid_project_id: projectId is not valid: pass the short project ID, as it appears in the catalog. Nothing was sent.
t3.send.invalid_thread_id: threadId is not valid: pass a thread's short ID, or omit it for the project's main thread. Nothing was sent.
t3.send.request_conflict: The identifier belongs to another request.
t3.send.repeat_rejected: This same send was already attempted ({{when}}) and was rejected before going out: nothing was sent then or now. If the user still wants it, a new call to t3_send_message is needed.
t3.send.repeat_released: This same send was already attempted ({{when}}) and was released without confirming its delivery. Nothing was sent now: this identifier is not resent. If the user wants it, a new call to t3_send_message is needed.
t3.send.repeat_uncertain: This same send was already attempted ({{when}}, {{where}}) and its delivery is uncertain: it may have arrived. Nothing was sent now. Do not repeat it; {{check}} and tell the user what you see.
t3.send.in_flight: Another send to this project is in progress right now ({{when}}, {{where}}); its delivery is still uncertain. Nothing was sent now. Wait for its result, {{check}} and do not repeat it.
t3.send.blocked: An earlier send to this project has an uncertain delivery ({{when}}, {{where}}): it may have arrived without an answer. For safety nothing more is sent to this project until it is cleared up. Nothing was sent now. {{Check}}: if its message is there ("Reference: {{reference}}"), the read records it as delivered and unblocks the project. If it is not, tell the user; only if they decide to unblock or resend, call t3_release_uncertain and then, if they asked, resend.
t3.send.no_thread_data: T3 did not return the data of the destination thread {{thread}}. Nothing was sent. Check the thread with t3_find_threads or t3_read_thread before proposing it again.
t3.send.wrong_project: Thread {{thread}} belongs to {{owner}}, not to "{{project}}". Nothing was sent. If it is the thread the user accepted, repeat the send with {{retry}}; if not, ask them.
t3.send.archived: Thread {{thread}} is archived and does not accept sends. Nothing was sent. Propose to the user sending it to the project's main thread (without threadId) or to another open thread, and wait for their yes.
t3.send.unconfirmed_thread: T3 answered the send without confirming the destination thread: the message may have reached thread {{thread}}. Do not repeat it; read that thread now with t3_read_thread and tell the user what you see.
t3.send.unconfirmed_new_thread: T3 answered without returning the ID of the new thread: "{{title}}" may have been created with the message. Do not repeat it; find it now with t3_find_threads, read it and tell the user what you see.
t3.release.unread: Before releasing it has to be checked: read thread {{thread}} now with t3_read_thread and tell the user whether their message is there. Nothing was changed.
t3.release.not_blocked: NOT BLOCKED: no uncertain send is blocking this project. Nothing was changed or sent.
t3.release.done: RELEASED: the uncertain send ({{when}}, {{where}}) stays unchecked, released by the user's decision. Nothing was sent. {{next}}
t3.release.more: Another uncertain send remains in this project: check it too.
t3.release.open: The project accepts sends again: if the user asked to resend it, use t3_send_message with the request they accepted.
orca.unknown_project: That projectId is not among the Orca projects. Use an ID from the catalog or find it with orca_list_projects; do not use IDs from another ADE.
orca.unknown_project_not_listed: That projectId is not among the Orca projects. Use an ID from the catalog or find it with orca_list_projects; do not use IDs from another ADE. Nothing was queried.
orca.schema: Orca: its CLI's answer does not have the format ADE Call expects (incompatible Orca version). Nothing was read or sent. Do not repeat it: tell the user; ADE Call or Orca needs updating.
orca.list.invalid_query: query is not valid: the name the user said, with at least one word or figure, or omit it to list everything. Nothing was queried.
orca.list.invalid_variants: variants must be a list of up to 5 non-empty texts (e.g. ["Whisper"]). Nothing was queried.
orca.read.missing_terminal: terminal is missing: the short terminal ID, from the catalog or orca_list_projects. Nothing was read.
orca.read.invalid_lines: lines must be an integer from 1 to {{max}} ({{default}} by default). Nothing was read.
orca.read.invalid_screen: screen must be true or false. Nothing was read.
orca.read.invalid_latest: latest must be true or false. Nothing was read.
orca.read.terminal_unavailable: Terminal not available in Orca (closed or unknown). Nothing was read: list again with orca_list_projects.
orca.read.terminal_other_project: That terminal belongs to project "{{project}}", not to the one given. Nothing was read: repeat the read without projectId or with that project's.
orca.target.missing_project_id: projectId is missing: the short project ID, as it appears in the catalog.
orca.target.terminal_gone: Terminal {{terminal}} no longer appears in Orca (closed or unknown). List again with orca_list_projects and propose another terminal to the user.
orca.target.terminal_other_project: Terminal {{terminal}} does not belong to project {{projectId}}. Use the projectId of that terminal's project according to orca_list_projects.
orca.target.unknown_workspace: Workspace {{worktreeId}} does not exist or does not belong to project {{projectId}}. List again with orca_list_projects and use a worktreeId of that project.
orca.send.missing_terminal: terminal is missing: the short ID of the agent's terminal, as it appears in the catalog. Nothing was sent.
orca.send.missing_message: message is missing: the text the user accepted (up to 32,000 characters). Nothing was sent.
orca.send.not_agent: Terminal {{terminal}} has no connected, writable agent (it is a shell, disconnected or read-only); nothing is sent to a shell. Propose to the user another terminal with an agent or starting one with orca_start_agent.
orca.start.missing_worktree_id: worktreeId is missing: the short workspace ID, as it appears in the catalog. Nothing was sent.
orca.start.invalid_agent: agent is not valid: the provider the user said, in lowercase (e.g. codex or claude). Nothing was sent.
orca.start.missing_message: message is missing: the request the user accepted (up to 32,000 characters). Nothing was sent.
orca.start.invalid_model: model is not valid: the model ID the user said, or omit it. Nothing was sent.
orca.start.effort_needs_model: effort requires model: also pass the model the user said, or omit effort. Nothing was sent.
orca.start.invalid_effort: effort is not valid: the reasoning level the user said (e.g. high), or omit it. Nothing was sent.
orca.send.request_conflict: This request already identifies another task.
orca.send.repeat_rejected: This same send was already attempted ({{when}}) and was rejected before going out: nothing was sent then or now. If the user still wants it, a new call to the tool is needed.
orca.send.repeat_released: This same send was already attempted ({{when}}) and was released without confirming its delivery. Nothing was sent now: this identifier is not resent. If the user wants it, a new call to the tool is needed.
orca.send.repeat_uncertain: This same send was already attempted ({{when}}, {{where}}) and its delivery is uncertain: it may have arrived. Nothing was sent now. Do not repeat it; {{check}} and tell the user what you see.
orca.send.in_flight: Another send to this project is in progress right now ({{when}}, {{where}}); its delivery is still uncertain. Nothing was sent now. Wait for its result, {{check}} and do not repeat it.
orca.send.blocked: An earlier send to this project has an uncertain delivery ({{when}}, {{where}}): it may have arrived without an answer. For safety nothing more is sent to this project until it is cleared up. Nothing was sent now. {{Check}} and tell the user what you see. Orca does not allow checking delivery by reference: if you do not see that it arrived and the user decides to unblock or resend, call orca_release_uncertain and then, if they asked, resend.
orca.send.uncertain: Uncertain delivery in Orca: there is no confirmed receipt of the send {{where}}, and it may have arrived. Do not repeat it; {{check}} and tell the user what you see.
orca.release.unread: Before releasing it has to be checked: read terminal {{terminal}} now with orca_read_terminal and tell the user what you see. Nothing was changed.
